stem: You want to show Google Ads to users who added to cart but did not buy. What should you do?

options.text: Create an audience that includes add_to_cart and excludes purchase, and share it with the linked Google Ads account
Create an exploration segment that includes add_to_cart and excludes purchase, and target it in Google Ads
Create a data filter that excludes purchase events, then target the remaining add_to_cart users with Google Ads campaigns
Mark add_to_cart as a key event and import it into the linked Google Ads account as a conversion to bid toward
